source_text: Non solum muri sed anathema: aurum argentum vas aeneum ferrum Domino sacrum. Qui de anathemate furatur populum contaminat. Prima victoria Domino dicanda; qui privatae cupiditati sacrata rapiunt, castra labefactant.
pass_a_gloss: Not only walls but ban: gold silver vessel bronze iron to-Lord sacred. Who from ban steals people contaminates. First victory to-Lord to-be-dedicated; who for-private greed sacred-things seize, camps weaken.
pass_b_english: Not only walls but the ban: [[gold, silver, bronze, and iron are sacred to the Lord >> Bible:Joshua 6:19]]. Whoever steals from the devoted things defiles the people. First victory must be dedicated to God; private greed for what is sacred weakens the camp.
